fixed_points: z=0 (multiplier F'(0)=3, |3|_2=1, 3 not root of unity); infinity parabolic (G(w)=w(1+w)/(1+3w), G'(0)=1); no other finite fixed point since F(z)-z=2z/(z+1)
multiplier_lemma: v2(3^m-1)=1 if m odd; =2+v2(m) if m even (LTE). Hence denom valuation d_k=v2(3^k-3) is 2 for even k, 3+v2(k-1) for odd k>=3
linearization: h(F)=3h(z), (3^k-3)b_k=sum_{j>=2}a_j[z^k]h^j; exact rational b_k computed to k=66
cancellation_obstacle: e.g. k=64: piece a2*2*b63 has v2~2+(-88)=-86 but v2(num64)=-29: massive cancellation among convolution terms defeats dominant-term induction
